text:
The most likely state is abnormal, seizure-like firing in the dopamine-producing brain areas, which drives excess dopamine release and explains the agitation, aggression, and threat-focused demands. Cell death in those areas would more typically cause a low-dopamine picture, which fits less well with this presentation. The "I need medication" claim could also reflect craving or withdrawal, so substance history and a check for delirium or other causes are still needed.

CONFIDENCE: 55
